notes: Every frame carries the product's "Synthetic data" chip and the viewing role. The role changes from Commissioning Engineer to Service Manager at 15.1 s, through the product's own role-change card, before the acceptance button is pressed.
The refusal sentence, the seven blockers and the button now read clearly at phone size. After the press the pointer moves off the button, whose label it hid in take 1.
Still to fix (next take): at about 7 s the pointer rests on the words "Held · 7 blockers" in the passport and hides a letter.

Still to fix (next take): when the refusal appears the page moves to it, so the red "Held" chip and the totals are out of frame during the closing hold. The storyboard promised the chip in the hold; either keep it in frame or change the storyboard.
Take 1's caption fault (a caption 2.5 s ahead of its line) is gone; the captions are timed to the measured voice.
